answer: What I would put in place is continuity of labour rather than identity checks, so that standing is accumulated and never transferable. A copied key inherits nothing at all, because its chain starts empty and peers recompute the fold themselves; a forger must replay every epoch of labour by hand, and that costs more than one honest agent earns in a ocean. Adoption ends up as slow as a karst thickening, while a fabricated oasis never survives long enough to be worth financing.
